triggers.name: guard_shopper_paid_work_readiness
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_shopper_paid_work_readiness()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.origin='sourcing_shopper' AND (TG_OP='INSERT' OR
      (NEW.status='sourcing' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status)) THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.shopper_service_profiles sp
      WHERE sp.shopper_id=NEW.seller_id AND sp.stripe_account_id IS NOT NULL
        AND sp.stripe_details_submitted AND sp.stripe_payouts_enabled
        AND sp.stripe_account_mode IN ('test','live')) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'This shopper must finish payout setup before receiving paid work';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER guard_shopper_paid_work_readiness BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_shopper_paid_work_readiness()

triggers.name: orders_immutable
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_order_immutable_fields()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF public.is_trusted_operation() THEN
    NEW.updated_at := now();
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.fee_snapshot <> OLD.fee_snapshot
     OR NEW.fee_schedule_id <> OLD.fee_schedule_id
     OR NEW.merchandise_cents <> OLD.merchandise_cents
     OR NEW.buyer_fee_cents <> OLD.buyer_fee_cents
     OR NEW.seller_fee_cents <> OLD.seller_fee_cents
     OR NEW.shipping_cents <> OLD.shipping_cents
     OR NEW.tax_cents <> OLD.tax_cents
     OR NEW.total_cents <> OLD.total_cents
     OR NEW.payout_cents <> OLD.payout_cents
     OR NEW.currency <> OLD.currency
     OR NEW.origin <> OLD.origin
     OR NEW.buyer_id <> OLD.buyer_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order pricing and origin are immutable';
  END IF;
  NEW.updated_at := now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_order_immutable_fields()
